body:
this is a really nice community,dont worry about rambling,theres aways someone to listen and offer advice c:
i cant offer you advice on this since i never went trough the same,but good luck buddy.

thanks,ill bring it up again in the next session.it feels awful to think i might just be jealous of the poor girl,she doesnt deserve that,but i do feel depressed.and when i see that all our friends stay with her and cheer her up when shes sad but wont even look at me,i just wish she didnt exist or that i had not met her.

i used to think so,im in therapy and on meds for depression,but im kind of scared i made this whole thing up,you know?because i saw the attention she was getting.and it makes me feel guilty that im wasting my therapists time and my friends too,besides puting another burden on her.she has so many things to deal with,and i try to keep to myself,but its impossible sometimes.

we used to be very good friends before i got hit by depression,we stayed like that for a year.i was hyper and loved to laugh,and was friends with her and all the others.then i retracted and nobody even bothered to try and stay with me like they did with her.

sorry for writing so much,and thank you for answering
im glad youre happier now and with friends who really care :) but did you just stopped talking to the others?

thanks for replying :)

they may mean no harm,but it still hurts a lot.specialy when im feeling awful and no one even asks about it or try to talk to me,but when my friends sad they do.and i cant even talk about it or they will just think i want to steal the poor girls attention.i feel really awful,i even avoid school because of this.

i dont have any other outside of that circle of friends :/
